classification.difficultyReason: Link algebraic rearrangement to boundary plotting and half-plane shading, reversing the inequality when dividing by a negative coefficient and preserving boundary inclusion.

content.prompt: Sketch the region for the following linear inequalities.

answer.short: $y<-\frac13x+3$. Dotted boundary through $(0,3)$ and $(9,0)$; shade below.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}x+3y&<9\\3y&<-x+9\\y&<-\frac13x+3\end{align*}$$
The boundary has intercepts $(0,3)$ and $(9,0)$. Draw it dotted because the inequality is strict. Shade below the line; the boundary is excluded.

spec.description: Ungriddded Cartesian graph with dotted descending boundary, labelled intercepts and a required-region legend. Origin O omitted under house convention; viewport chosen to show both intercepts.
spec.mathematics: Boundary y=-x/3+3 through (0,3) and (9,0); required half-plane y<-x/3+3.

answer.short: $y\le3x-3$. Solid boundary through $(0,-3)$ and $(1,0)$; shade below.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}3x-y&\ge3\\-y&\ge3-3x\\y&\le3x-3\end{align*}$$
Dividing by $-1$ reverses the inequality. The boundary has intercepts $(0,-3)$ and $(1,0)$. Draw it solid and shade below the line, including the boundary.

spec.description: Ungriddded Cartesian graph with solid ascending boundary, labelled intercepts and required-region legend. The region below the steep boundary lies to its right in the displayed viewport. Origin O omitted.
spec.mathematics: Boundary y=3x-3 through (0,-3) and (1,0); required half-plane y<=3x-3.

answer.short: $y\ge-2x+4$. Solid boundary through $(0,4)$ and $(2,0)$; shade above.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}4x+2y&\ge8\\2y&\ge-4x+8\\y&\ge-2x+4\end{align*}$$
The boundary has intercepts $(0,4)$ and $(2,0)$. Draw it solid and shade above the line, including the boundary.

spec.description: Ungriddded Cartesian graph with solid descending boundary, labelled intercepts and required-region legend. Origin O omitted.
spec.mathematics: Boundary y=-2x+4 through (0,4) and (2,0); required half-plane y>=-2x+4.

answer.short: $y\le\frac23x-6$. Solid boundary through $(0,-6)$ and $(9,0)$; shade below.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}2x-3y&\ge18\\-3y&\ge18-2x\\y&\le\frac23x-6\end{align*}$$
Dividing by $-3$ reverses the inequality. The boundary has intercepts $(0,-6)$ and $(9,0)$. Draw it solid and shade below the line, including the boundary.

spec.mathematics: Boundary y=2x/3-6 through (0,-6) and (9,0); required half-plane y<=2x/3-6.

answer.short: $y\le2x+5$. Solid boundary through $(0,5)$ and $(-2.5,0)$; shade below.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}-2x+y&\le5\\y&\le2x+5\end{align*}$$
For the $x$-intercept, $0=2x+5$, so $x=-\frac52=-2.5$. The $y$-intercept is $5$. Draw a solid boundary through $(-2.5,0)$ and $(0,5)$, then shade below it, including the boundary.

spec.mathematics: Boundary y=2x+5 through (-2.5,0) and (0,5); required half-plane y<=2x+5.

answer.short: $y\le\frac12x+\frac32$. Solid boundary through $(0,1.5)$ and $(-3,0)$; shade below.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}-2x+4y&\le6\\4y&\le2x+6\\y&\le\frac12x+\frac32\end{align*}$$
The boundary has intercepts $(-3,0)$ and $(0,\frac32)$. Draw it solid and shade below the line, including the boundary.
